title: A Unified Issue Resolution Benchmark for Requirement Clarification, Planning, and Code Generation for Coding Agents
abstract: SWE-RPG evaluates requirement clarification, planning, code generation, and submission on repository tasks; implicit requirement recovery is a major bottleneck.

title: ClarifyCodeBench: Evaluating LLMs on Clarifying Ambiguous Requirements for Code Generation
abstract: An interactive benchmark for requirement ambiguity; coding strength and clarification strength are decoupled, and performance drops with ambiguity density.

title: How Do Developers Maintain and Evolve Their Agents' Instructions? An Empirical Study
abstract: A mining study proposal on maintenance and evolution of agent context files and their association with code outcomes.

title: The Spec Growth Engine: Spec-Anchored, Code-Coupled, Drift-Enforced Architecture for AI-Assisted Software Development
abstract: A proposed lightweight spec graph and drift gate for controlling context growth and spec-code divergence.

title: RoadmapBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Agentic Software Development Across Version Upgrades
abstract: A benchmark of 115 long-horizon version-upgrade tasks showing current agents remain weak on multi-file roadmap work.

title: Evaluating AGENTS.md: Are Repository-Level Context Files Helpful for Coding Agents?
abstract: Repository context files often reduce task success and increase inference cost; unnecessary requirements are particularly harmful.

title: Agent READMEs: An Empirical Study of Context Files for Agentic Coding
abstract: A large-scale study of 2303 context files showing emphasis on architecture and implementation, with sparse security and performance guidance.

title: An Empirical Study of Developer-Provided Context for AI Coding Assistants in Open-Source Projects
abstract: A taxonomy based on 401 repositories containing Cursor rules, covering conventions, guidelines, project facts, directives, and examples.

title: When Instructions Multiply: Measuring and Estimating LLM Capabilities of Multiple Instructions Following
abstract: ManyIFEval and StyleMBPP show instruction-following performance consistently degrades as instruction count rises.

title: CFBench: A Comprehensive Constraints-Following Benchmark for LLMs
abstract: A 1000-sample benchmark with manually annotated criteria showing persistent difficulty in multi-constraint following.

title: Recovering from Misbehaviors in Coding Agents
abstract: A study and recovery framework for coding-agent misbehavior including specification drift and reasoning failures.

title: Toward User Comprehension Supports for LLM Agent Skill Specifications
abstract: An audit of 878 cybersecurity skills finds capability boundaries and examples are commonly missing from specifications.

title: SPECA: Specification-to-Checklist Agentic Auditing for Multi-Implementation Systems
abstract: Turns normative specifications into reusable property checklists and studies gaps caused by implicit assumptions and concurrency details.

title: SkillsBench: Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks
abstract: A cross-domain benchmark showing curated skills can help while excess, self-generated, or mismatched skills can hurt.
